What We Offer

Our Product Lines

We partner with insurance providers in all 50 states offering contracts for Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement, Life Insurance, Dental, Vision and Hearing coverage, ACA, Annuities, and various other supplemental options for independent insurance agents throughout the United States.

Get Certified

Medicare Advantage plans are a dynamic opportunity for agents to grow their business and boost earnings. These plans provide clients with comprehensive healthcare solutions, including additional benefits like dental, vision, and prescription coverage—all at affordable costs. For agents, they offer strong commissions, annual renewals, and access to an ever-growing Medicare-eligible population.

With year-round cross-selling opportunities and full support from our caring team—including training, tools, resources, and top carrier contracts—you’ll have everything you need to succeed in this expanding market!

Explore MAPD

Medicare Supplement plans are a reliable way to grow your business while meeting the needs of your clients. With lifetime renewals and stable commissions, they offer long-term income potential. Clients benefit from predictable healthcare costs and the freedom to choose any Medicare-accepting doctor or hospital nationwide, building trust and loyalty. As an agent, you’ll enjoy year-round selling opportunities and bonuses, straightforward plan options, and high demand from seniors.

Partner with us for access to leading carriers, competitive payouts, and tools and resources to help you thrive in this growing market!

Explore Med Supp

Life Insurance and Annuity plans are powerful tools for agents looking to provide financial security for clients while boosting their own earning potential. These plans offer clients peace of mind by protecting their loved ones and creating stable retirement income, while agents benefit from strong commissions, cross-selling opportunities, and the potential to build lasting client relationships.

With growing demand for wealth protection and retirement planning solutions, selling these products positions you as a trusted advisor. Partner with us to access top carriers, expert training, and the resources you need to thrive in this lucrative market!

Explore Life InsuranceExplore Annuities

Hospital Indemnity plans are a powerful add-on for agents looking to enhance their portfolio and increase revenue. These affordable, customizable plans help clients cover out-of-pocket costs like hospital stays, surgeries, and more—filling critical gaps in their insurance coverage. For agents, they offer strong commission potential, easy cross-selling opportunities with Medicare Advantage plans, and a chance to provide clients with valuable peace of mind.

Partner with us to access top carriers, expert training, and the tools you need to grow your business with these highly sought-after solutions!

Explore Hospital Indemnity

Affordable Care Act (ACA) plans are a valuable opportunity for agents to expand their client base and income. With millions of Americans relying on affordable health coverage through the ACA marketplace, these plans provide year-round earning potential, high demand during Open Enrollment, and competitive commissions. For clients, ACA plans offer essential coverage, subsidies to lower costs, and broad options to match their needs.

Partner with us to access top-tier carriers, expert training, and comprehensive tools and resources to help you succeed in this continually growing market!

Explore ACA

Find Out Why Agents Partner with Us

As a contracted Tidewater agent, you will get access to top-notch support, proprietary technology, competitive commissions, resources, and tools to help fuel your business growth.

  • Cutting-Edge Technology

    Get access to our proprietary technology and tools to help consumers find the right coverage they need. Compliantly manage clients, compare plans, get quotes, electronically enroll clients, get leads, and more with the Integrity Technology Suite.

    • IntegrityCONNECT™: Boost your success with a single, powerful platform tailored for professionals who thrive on building relationships; this world-class technology helps agents write up to 79% more applications.

    • CSG Actuarial: Boost efficiency and stay ahead with CSG Actuarial’s advanced tool suite—streamline operations and confidently grow your business.

    • PlanEnroll: a consumer-facing platform that helps you engage and connect with current and future clients, helping you build stronger relationships.

    • Turning 65 Locator: A powerful tool for finding Medicare Supplement prospects who will be turning 65 soon. Become their trusted resource to help them navigate Medicare.

    Explore Technology

  • VIP Portal

    Unlock success with our custom agent portal, your hub for training, resources, carrier previews, and incentives.

    • Resource Hub: Reach more clients using our marketing resources, customizable templates, guides, resources, and more.

    • TMG University: Sharpen your skills and industry knowledge with guides and training videos.

    • Carrier Incentives and TMG Trip: Supplement your commissions with lucrative bonuses and a chance to win a spot on our annual trip.

    • Agent Frequently Asked Questions: Common questions we are asked on a daily basis within the insurance industry. Have a question yourself? Ask it!

    Become a Tidewater VIP

  • Lead Opportunities

    Tidewater Management Group has some fantastic agent programs for new brokers as well as seasoned producers to expand their book of business. Get real-time access to millions of compliant leads with our new platform LeadCENTER.

    Get Leads

  • Great Support All The Time

    Call us at (888) 622-9122. If you need help after hours, simply fill out a support ticket or email support@tidewatermg.com.

    Get Support

  • The Medicare Broker Community

    Become part of a private FaceBook community with like-minded agents by joining in on live announcements, trainings, and the latest updates you need to know right now.

    Join the Community

Get Started Selling Insurance in 3 Easy Steps!

  • Submit Your Info

    Send us your basic agent details like your state license number, voided check, and E&O Insurance, and we’ll start your contracting paperwork behind the scenes.

  • Get Appointed

    We guide you through everything you need like background checks, AML, and any carrier‑specific certifications such as Medicare or life products. No guesswork!

  • Start Selling

    Once your carrier appointments are approved, you’ll get access to quoting tools, IntegrityCONNECT, training and resources so you can start writing business right away.
